union_rule_bb_blocks.run_disagreement: The two archival runs disagree on the union tally (2 vs 0) and on the AIC winner in 4 of 11 rows. Seed/multistart variance at this amplitude is exactly the L8 class of artifact. Neither tally may be quoted as a result; both are recorded so the fresh L18+ number can be judged against the spread, not against a single run.
union_rule_bb_blocks.baseline_dependence: THE headline of the 2026-08-08 record is at risk. That record states the burst is a 'clean NULL' on the thermal axis, citing 'LRT(Band+BB vs Band) < 4 in all 10 blocks'. That statement is TRUE and is also ONLY the Band+BB pair. Under the union rule the CPL+BB pair fires at LRT = 18.14 and 11.97 in the same table. This is the T8 lesson in the flesh: a BB verdict is a statement about a NAMED baseline. The correct archival statement is: Band-baseline NULL everywhere; CPL-baseline detection in 2 of 10 blocks.
union_rule_bb_blocks.counter_evidence_against_those_two_firin: Chang+2026, on this burst over a matched 0-20 s GBM window, report BOTH CPL+BB and Band+BB as 'Non-Con.' (unconstrained posteriors) and derive a maximum allowed pseudo-photospheric kT_max = 30.10 keV with magnetization sigma > 14.38. The two archival firings carry kT = 80.18 and 54.88 keV, i.e. 1.8x and 2.7x ABOVE that ceiling. The physically-motivated reading is that they are CPL-continuum-deficiency artifacts, not photospheres (T7).

archival_prior.kT_track_note: There is NO monotonic kT track here, in either pair. The Band+BB kT wanders 1.0-24.4 keV with several values railed at the 1.0 keV floor (blocks 1, 4), and the CPL+BB kT jumps 3.15 -> 80.18 -> 1.58 -> 54.88 -> 75.18 keV between adjacent blocks. That is the signature of an unconstrained nuisance component, not of a cooling photosphere - and it is consistent with Chang+2026's 'Non-Con.'

predictions: P-A (Ep track, falsifiable): the fresh L18+ Ep(t) over the stamped window is HARD-TO-SOFT overall, matching Duan & Wang 2020's h.t.s. classification. Concretely: (i) the time-integrated (block -1) nuFnu Ep lands in 620-820 keV, bracketing our archival 764.8 keV and Duan's 685.4 +/- 78.3 keV, and ABOVE Chang+2026's 558.8 keV; (ii) the first block (0-4.9 s) is the hardest and either returns Ep > 1500 keV or is flagged BOUND_CAPPED (the archival value 3721 keV comes with a beta railed at -5.00 and BAND_VALID=False, so it is not a measurement); (iii) the last block (20.2-26.3 s) lands in 420-580 keV. FALSIFIED if the integrated Ep < 550 keV or > 950 keV, or if the last block's Ep exceeds 700 keV, or if a well-constrained Ep(t) rises monotonically.

P-A2 (alpha, falsifiable, cheap and sharp): NO block with a well-constrained fit returns alpha > -2/3. Duan & Wang 2020 Table 3 records 'alpha > -2/3: no' for this burst across all 5 of their bins, and our archival alpha spans -0.760 (blk 2, the hardest) to -1.346. FALSIFIED if any block with S >= 20 and a passing adequacy gate returns alpha > -0.667, which would put this burst above the synchrotron line of death and contradict both Duan and our own prior.

P-B (BB / union rule, falsifiable, THE decisive prediction): under the L18+ engine the union rule ((LRT_BANDBB_BAND >= 9.2 & kT > 1.05) OR (LRT_CPLBB_CPL >= 9.2 & kT > 1.05)) fires in AT MOST 3 of ~10 blocks, and if it fires at all it fires through the CPL+BB pair, not the Band+BB pair. Sub-prediction with teeth: the two archival firings (blk 2, kT = 80.18 keV; blk 5, kT = 54.88 keV) do NOT survive - their kT exceeds Chang+2026's maximum allowed pseudo-photospheric kT_max = 30.10 keV by 1.8x and 2.7x, and Chang finds CPL+BB posteriors 'Non-Con.' on a matched window, so they should read as CPL-continuum-deficiency artifacts (T7) rather than photospheres. FALSIFIED if (a) the union tally reaches 5 or more blocks, or (b) the Band+BB pair fires with LRT >= 9.2 anywhere - it is silent at max 3.93 in the archival prior and unconstrained in Chang, so a Band-baseline firing would be a genuinely new result, or (c) a firing block survives the adequacy gate with kT > 30.10 keV, which would directly contradict Chang's sigma > 14.38.

P-B2 (baseline dependence, falsifiable): the two nested tests DISAGREE at the 9.2 threshold in at least 1 block, and the disagreement runs in the direction CPL+BB > Band+BB (the CPL baseline is the poorer continuum here, since SBPL/SBPLfree win 4 of 11 archival rows on AIC). FALSIFIED if the two tests agree block-for-block, or if Band+BB ever exceeds CPL+BB by more than 9.2 in the same block. This is the direct test of the T8 lesson and the reason the union rule exists.

P-C (two-break, falsifiable): AT MOST ONE block prefers DSBPL, and no block reaches a decisive two-break detection. The archival max LRT_DSBPL_SBPL is 3.67 (blk 2) and DSBPL never wins on AIC in either archival run. Sub-prediction: if any DSBPL preference appears it sits in blocks 1, 2, 5 or 6 with a lower break XB in 150-400 keV - NOT below 25 keV. FALSIFIED as a real two-break detection if 3 or more blocks prefer DSBPL, or if every DSBPL win places XB below ~25 keV (the NaI low-energy rail artifact), or if a DSBPL win appears in the beta-railed blocks 0/4/7/9 where the Band fit itself is invalid.

P-D (no extra high-energy component, falsifiable): dAICsimp shows no requirement for a component beyond a simple continuum in ANY block. Three independent published tests agree: de Ugarte Postigo+2013 (joint GBM+LLE, 10-200 MeV) find 'no emerging high-energy extra component is evident'; Sharma+2021 try Band+PL and Band+CPL jointly with LLE and report none; and Ajello+2019 places the first >100 MeV photon at T_LAT,0 = 73.7 s, 47 s after our window closes. FALSIFIED if any block with a passing adequacy gate prefers a +PL or +CPL component by dAIC >= 10 - which, given T_LAT,0, would demand an explanation that is NOT the published LAT detection.

P-E (lag sign, falsifiable, and it settles an internal contradiction): once the sign convention is pinned to the standard 'positive lag = soft lags hard', this burst's spectral lag is POSITIVE. Duan & Wang 2020 Sect. 5 names 120624B as one of six h.t.s. bursts that must show a positive lag. Our own records currently CONTRADICT EACH OTHER: results/walkthrough_b4/bn120624933_temporal.ecsv stores LAG_S = -0.96192 s while notes/reconciliation/bn120624933.md D10 quotes +0.962 s. FALSIFIED if the convention-resolved lag is negative, which would put us against Duan's classification and require the h.t.s. call itself to be re-examined.

P-F (scope / like-for-like, falsifiable, procedural): if the fresh sweep106 run for this burst is GBM-only (n0,n1,n2,b0), then it is NOT like-for-like with the archival prior recorded here, because every archival table on disk carries an 'lle' plugin and two blocks additionally carry 'LAT'. FALSIFIED - i.e. the comparison IS like-for-like - only if the fresh run's PLUGIN_DETS matches 'n0,n1,n2,b0,lle'. Whichever way it lands, the detector set must be stated before any archival-vs-fresh delta is attributed to the engine.
